serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Onspring GovCloud is a FedRAMP-authorized, cloud-based platform designed to support government governance, risk management, and compliance programs. It helps agencies centralize and structure data, enforce data integrity and access controls, manage workflows and deliver real-time reporting across critical processes.

Agencies use Onspring GovCloud to support programs such as OMB A-123, POA&M, and other GRC initiatives, as well as related operational processes. The platform enables agencies to configure and extend out-of-the-box solutions while accommodating agency-specific requirements without added complexity.

Onspring GovCloud also includes AI-powered capabilities that help teams accelerate documentation, improve consistency, surface insights, and reduce manual effort, while maintaining appropriate controls, transparency, and human oversight.
